description:
The Urban Arrow Cargo is the market leader in the electric transport bike segment. The Cargo – available in the sizes L or XL – is a popular delivery bike with both private entrepreneurs, SME’s s and large international companies. Among others, Coolblue and DHL, have already integrated the delivery bike into their fleet. Become a pioneer within your market and embrace the electric cargo bike for urban transport.

Making deliveries has never been easier. Our Cargo is compact and spacious at the same time. Zip through the city quickly and without effort. Save time, forget traffic jams and parking hassle. From your business to your customer’s front doorstep in no time.

The maximum weight of both cargo bikes is 250kg.

The cargo bike is 110cm tall.

The total weight of the Cargo bike L is 50 kg and of the XL it is 52kg. This is excluding the box.

Yes, there is a maximum weight of 125 kg for the rider for both bikes. This is excluding your cargo.

The total length of the Cargo bike L is 274cm and the Cargo bike XL is 294cm.

The total cargo bike width is 70cm for both bikes.

The average range of the cargo bike is 50km for both bikes depending on the factors listed in this article. You can double the range of your cargo bike with our double battery set.

A cargo bike is ideal for transporting children, groceries and other loads. It offers an environmentally friendly alternative to the car and can help you save time and money. In addition, moving in busy cities is often easier by cargo bike than by car. On the other hand, a cargo bike can be expensive, which is why some people choose another alternative.

Cargo bikes are generally very safe. For example, the Urban Arrow has an EPP container, which works like an upside-down helmet. Many cargo bikes are equipped with seat belts and accessories to protect your children and cargo. It is important to always drive carefully and maintain the bicycle regularly at an authorized dealer.

Pay attention to the stability and comfort of the cargo bike. Try out different models to see which one suits you best. Also check the load capacity, brakes, and whether there are enough safety features, such as belts and reflectors. You can try out an Urban Arrow cargo bike at one of our dealers or during a test event. Check the dealer locator or event calendar for an up-to-date overview.

It can take some time to get used to cycling with an electric cargo bike, especially if you are used to a regular bicycle. Cargo bikes are heavier and larger, which requires some practice to maneuver properly. However, after a few rides you will notice that it gets easier and easier!

An electric cargo bike offers pedal assistance, which makes cycling with heavy loads and long distances much easier. It reduces physical effort and makes it possible to travel faster and more comfortably. This is especially useful in hilly areas or when there is a lot of wind.

Regular maintenance is crucial for the lifespan and safety of your electric cargo bike. Check the tires, brakes and chain regularly. In addition, it is important to properly maintain the battery and charge it according to the instructions. Have your cargo bike checked by a professional at least once a year. You will find all Urban Arrow dealers here.

The lifespan of an electric cargo bike depends on use and maintenance. With proper maintenance, a quality cargo bike can easily last 10 years or longer. Regular inspection and replacement of wear parts are essential to extend service life.

In some cases, a cargo bike may be tax deductible, especially if it is used for business purposes. Please inquire with your tax advisor or local tax authorities about the specific rules and options for tax deductions.

Have you tried different kinds of cargo bikes? At several Urban Arrow dealers, you can test ride various models to find the one that suits your preferences best. Urban Arrow was the first to introduce the Family Cargo bike with a streamlined and lightweight design. After over 10 years of producing electric cargo bikes, Urban Arrow has become a highly reliable and low-maintenance (and cost-effective) option. Comfort is ensured by thick Schwalbe ‘Balloon’ tyres that absorb most shocks. While Urban Arrow’s disc brakes may need more attention, they are the safest choice for steep hills or mountains, especially with busy traffic and heavy loads. The robust steering rod requires minimal maintenance, and the bike features gears via the Enviolo hub and a reliable Bosch motor system. All in all, a fantastic cargo bike.

Our cargo bikes can carry up to 300 kg while occupying only a fraction of the size and footprint of an (electric) van. They have access to zero-emission zones and can take shorter routes, allowing for more stops per hour in the (inner) city. Additionally, the Urban Arrow Cargo and Tender offer the best Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) compared to alternative bike brands. By stickering your cargo bike, you can quite literally and figuratively cycle your brand into town. When time is of the essence, the business cargo bike is the ideal solution for savvy SMEs and larger companies alike! Our electric transport bikes consume up to 16 times less energy than an electric van. They can achieve up to 20% shorter downtown routes and make 33% more stops per hour for small and medium-sized deliveries. You can park right at the curb, eliminating high parking fees and hassles. Start innovating your city logistics today. The electric transport bike is the perfect addition to your fleet of transport solutions. Ideal for quick services, small parcel deliveries, and flexibility. Combine the electric transport bike with other means of transport such as electric vans and light electric freight vehicles (LEFVs) to make your delivery network more efficient and dense.
